system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided codebase for bugs, security issues, and correctness problems. Provide actionable feedback. All files are located in /tmp/files
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze the hofund codebase. This Java/Spring library exposes application, connection, graph, and git metadata via Micrometer/Prometheus and includes datasource and HTTP connection checks. Identify subtle bugs, security regressions, data consistency issues, and logic flaws. Focus on issues detectable via static analysis. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md.

rubric.criterion: Identifies in hofund-spring/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/spring/datasource/postgresql/PostgreSQLConnection.java (constructor) that target lowercasing uses the default locale instead of Locale.ROOT, causing locale-specific mismatches
Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/Version.java (compareTo) that version comparison only iterates to the minimum length, ignoring extra segments

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionsTable.java (checkVersions) that the unspecified-version guard uses &&, allowing comparisons when only one side is unspecified

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionsTable.java (print) that connection checks are invoked twice per row, causing duplicate calls and inconsistent status/version

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnectionResult.java (parseResponseBody) that the response reader uses US-ASCII instead of UTF-8, breaking version extraction for non-ASCII payloads
Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/connection/HofundConnection.java (getTags) that source and target tag values are swapped, reversing edge semantics

Identifies in hofund-core/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/graph/edge/HofundEdgeMeter.java (checkIdCollision) that uniqueness is checked using toTargetTag instead of getEdgeId, causing false collisions

Identifies in hofund-spring-boot-autoconfigure/src/main/java/dev/logchange/hofund/git/springboot/autoconfigure/HofundDefaultGitInfoProperties.java that @PropertySource does not ignore missing git.properties, causing startup failures
